# Paul Murphy | Data & AI Systems

> Paul Murphy is a Maryland-based data and AI systems consultant. He designs analytics platforms, operational forecasting and decision systems, and governed applied AI for complex operations.

Canonical site: https://www.paulymurph.com

## Consulting capabilities

- Microsoft Fabric and analytics platform modernization: governed lakehouse architecture, data engineering, semantic models, Power BI, deployment, and FinOps.
- Forecasting and decision systems: production planning, optimization, unit economics, scenarios, schedules, and operating decisions.
- Applied AI systems: agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), FastAPI, FastMCP, identity, governed tools, and production delivery.

## Evidence

- [Selected work](https://www.paulymurph.com/work): Three connected systems spanning commercial analytics, platform architecture, and production AI. They are not presented as separate clients or engagements.
- [Fabric platform modernization](https://www.paulymurph.com/work/fabric-modernization): 60%+ lower infrastructure cost, overnight processing reduced from 20 minutes to 3, hourly operational refreshes, and 300+ users and leaders supported.
- [Forecasting and unit economics](https://www.paulymurph.com/work/complexity-to-unit-economics): Five agreed complexity tiers, weekly production planning, and typical output within +/-10% of the client target at 4,000+ assets processed daily.
- [Governed applied AI](https://www.paulymurph.com/work/governed-ai-analytics): Production web and Teams access through Entra, Foundry agents, Fabric Data Agents, Fabric MCP, and custom FastMCP/FastAPI tools.
